# PDF-lib 1.17.1

The browser distribution and MIT licence were copied without modification from the installed `pdf-lib` package in the sibling `DSMR_TSAAT/node_modules/pdf-lib` directory. No network download was used. The package metadata reports version **1.17.1**.

| File | Installed source | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pdf-lib.min.js` | `dist/pdf-lib.min.js` | `0f9a5cad07941f0826586c94e089d89b918c46e5c17cf2d5a3c6f666e3bc694f` |
| `LICENSE.md` | `LICENSE.md` | `f2c9fc00fdb66eb99ac156ba52d734af66d8d309f65753ae809ad34ee2883bcb` |

The guide builder embeds the distribution and licence in the standalone HTML. PDF-lib supplies the browser PDF runtime exposed as `PDFLib`; the guide's own modules supply the document content and layout. The original companion app remains unchanged.
